character-design, family-coherence, accessibility, sustainability and museum-brand principles to govern decisions."},{"id":"process_model","objective":"Define a repeatable workflow connecting source cat-character narratives, visual languages and product-family directions grounded in documented research."},{"id":"select_direction","objective":"Compare concepts against the agreed principles and museum-brand relationship and usage rules."},{"id":"structure_spec","objective":"Define the product architecture, categories, SKU hierarchy, dimensions, materials, artwork zones and differentiation logic."},{"id":"prototype_test","objective":"Create representative rough prototypes and evaluate appeal, recognizability, usability, manufacturability, durability and cultural interpretation."},{"id":"refine","objective":"Apply documented testing and stakeholder feedback while preserving approved cultural, character and product-system decisions."},{"id":"expand_assets","objective":"Extend the approved direction consistently across the agreed merchandise family and SKU variants."},{"id":"production_file","objective":"Prepare category-specific manufacturing masters and specifications after supplier requirements and approvals are available."}] replace the museum logo.","The source culture and museum collection will be identified during intake rather than inferred from the brief.","Cultural interpretation will be reviewed by qualified stakeholders with authority to request changes.","The initial family will use a limited set of representative product categories before wider SKU expansion.","Prototype and production outputs are conditional on receiving category-specific supplier and compliance information.","Packaging, ecommerce content and product photography are outside scope unless subsequently commissioned."],"stop_conditions":["Do not begin culture-specific concept development until the museum property, source culture and authoritative source materials are identified.","Stop any direction that relies on unsupported cultural claims, sacred or restricted material, stereotypes or decontextualized symbols until qualified review resolves it.","Do not use museum marks, collection imagery or culturally owned material without documented permission.","Do not select a direction without an explicit decision from the designated client and required cultural or curatorial reviewers.","Do not expand the family until the character/product direction and its governing principles are approved.","Do not advance representative designs to production if prototype testing reveals unresolved cultural, safety, usability, durability or manufacturability issues.","Do not prepare manufacturing-ready files without final product dimensions, materials, print methods, supplier templates, tolerances and compliance requirements.","Do not hand off production assets until licensing, curatorial, cultural, brand, legal and technical approvals are recorded."],"rationale":"The workflow
